text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While on my way to the office, I bump into Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: C'mon, drop that already. I've just been kind of obsessed with watching chess tournament videos late into the night.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: They're fun and make me think about what I would have done. Plus I can learn new strategies too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The matches are so intense. I'd love to play in one someday.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yawn… I couldn't manage a match right now though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky dreams of a chess showdown, but it looks like the sandman already has her in checkmate.
